title: Čech complex and cohomology commute with the first finite covering limit
statement:
Let $X$ be affine, $\Lambda$ a finite discrete ring, $F$ an étale sheaf of left $\Lambda$-modules, and $M=\nu_X^*F$ [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Let $\mathcal V=\{V_a\to U\}_{a=1}^m$ be a nonempty finite basis covering and choose the first-limit systems $\mathcal V_j$ and $T_{\alpha,j}$ of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-intersection-limit-compatibility]. The canonical restriction maps give an isomorphism of cochain complexes of abelian groups
$$\varinjlim_j\check C^\bullet(\mathcal V_j,M)\xrightarrow{\sim}\check C^\bullet(\mathcal V,M),$$
and induce isomorphisms $\varinjlim_j\check H^q(\mathcal V_j,M)\xrightarrow{\sim}\check H^q(\mathcal V,M)$ for every $q\ge0$. The complexes are the ordered alternating Čech complexes of [def-weil-pbc-cover-cech], including repeated indices. No injectivity of $F$ is assumed.

proof.text: Reindex the given coordinate presentations along the opposite evaluation functors from the product of directed sets. These functors are initial. Reflect the underlying scheme limit cones through the fully faithful affine ind-etale inclusion. For each ordered nonempty tuple, construct its intersection diagram and cone using the universal property in SiteCechComplex. A cone over the intersection diagram projects to cones over the individual coordinate diagrams; their limit lifts have the same composite to the base (test at any stage), so the intersection universal property supplies the unique lift. This proves the intersection cone limiting for the actual given systems, without choosing new presentations.

Apply classical set continuity to the underlying set sheaf of F. The sheaf pullback/forgetful comparison identifies the underlying sets of the module pullback with that set pullback; the module forgetful functor preserves filtered colimits and reflects colimit cocones. This proves continuity of the module pullback on the affine basis. The abelian presheaf underlying the module pullback is already a sheaf, so its sheafification unit is an isomorphism; forgetting modules to abelian groups gives continuity of firstLimitClassicalPresheaf.

Apply this continuity to each intersection limit cone. In a fixed degree the tuple set is finite. Given a tuple of elements in the limiting section groups, choose one stage representative for each coordinate and then a common upper stage. Given equality of two product representatives, use eventual equality in every coordinate, coequalize the two arrows witnessing that equality, and then take a common upper stage for this finite wide span. The concrete filtered-colimit representative/equality criterion proves that the product section cocone is colimiting. No product over all degrees is interchanged.

Construct the complex transition maps and cocone legs by applying the coefficient presheaf to the unique projection-compatible intersection maps. Intersection uniqueness gives identity, composition, cocone naturality, and compatibility with deleting a factor. Contravariance, additivity and the alternating finite sum prove differential compatibility. Uniqueness also proves precisely the two restriction formulas in the theorem.

The product cocones prove the complex cocone colimiting after evaluation in every natural degree; the degreewise colimit theorem makes it colimiting in complexes. After extension by zero, evaluation in an integer degree in the image of the embedding is naturally isomorphic to the original evaluation; outside the image it is a zero cocone. Hence the extended cocone is colimiting too. The universal comparison from the chosen colimit is consequently an isomorphism.

Filtered colimits of abelian groups are exact, shrinking the universe size to that of the directed product if needed. Homology preserves these colimits. Therefore applying every nonnegative homology functor to the same cocone gives a colimiting cocone, whose canonical colimit.desc is an isomorphism. Degree zero is included by the existing homological-complex homology API.

proof_origin.note: Complete Lean proof using the given coordinate limits, set continuity, the pullback/forget comparison, concrete finite-product colimits and degreewise exact-colimit homology.
